# Lab 12.6: Hyperparameter Tuning

## What We Are Going to Do
Let BigQuery ML try several hyperparameter combinations and pick the best boosted tree model.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Train with tuning.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.income_bt_tuned
OPTIONS (
  model_type = 'BOOSTED_TREE_CLASSIFIER',
  input_label_cols = ['income_bracket'],
  num_trials = 10,
  max_parallel_trials = 2,
  hparam_tuning_objectives = ['ROC_AUC'],
  learn_rate = HPARAM_RANGE(0.01, 0.3),
  max_tree_depth = HPARAM_CANDIDATES([4, 6, 8]),
  subsample = HPARAM_RANGE(0.5, 1.0)
) AS
SELECT * FROM lab12.v_income;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] See every trial.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT trial_id, hyperparameters, hparam_tuning_evaluation_metrics.roc_auc AS auc, is_optimal
FROM ML.TRIAL_INFO(MODEL lab12.income_bt_tuned)
ORDER BY auc DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Evaluate the best trial.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab12.income_bt_tuned);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   By default, `ML.EVALUATE` and `ML.PREDICT` use the optimal trial.

4. **[Console] Look at the trials chart.** Open the model's **Evaluation** tab and pick different trials from the trial list.

5. **[CLI] List the trials from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT trial_id, is_optimal, hparam_tuning_evaluation_metrics.roc_auc AS auc FROM ML.TRIAL_INFO(MODEL lab12.income_bt_tuned) ORDER BY auc DESC'</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Trials | 10 combinations tried |
| Search space | Ranges and candidate lists |
| Best trial | `is_optimal = TRUE` |
| Default use | Prediction uses the best trial |
